kv22.4:1.3: Atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammasavanaṃ, dhammasākacchā, paripucchā, sīlasamādānaṃ, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogo ti?
kv22.4:1.5: N' atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā --pe-- jāgariyānuyogo ti?
kv22.4:1.7: Hañci n' atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā --pe-- jāgariyānuyogo, no vata re vattabbe
kv22.4:2.4: parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro ti?
kv22.4:2.7: parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro, no vata re vattabbe
kv22.4:3.3: Suttassa pamattassa muṭṭhasatissa asampajānassa dhammābhisamayo ti?
